subjects.ember_resin: One compact viscous ember-resin glob with a dark cooled rind and bright orange molten center.
subjects.fire_bloom_seed: One plump biological seed with burnt segmented shell, asymmetric oval shape, and small ember-orange germ or crown; seed, not flame or mineral.
subjects.furnace_chitin: One curved layered furnace-chitin plate with dark segmented armor ridges and a restrained ember-orange seam.
subjects.heatstone: One common dense dark heatstone chunk with a simple ember-orange thermal fissure; rough and less refined than basalt core.
subjects.smolder_bark: One split strip of charcoal bark with layered wood grain and a narrow ember-orange smolder seam.
subjects.sulfur_cluster: One bright yellow sulfur crystal cluster on a small dark basalt base, with restrained warm orange accents.
subjects.volcanic_glass_shard: One long asymmetric black volcanic-glass shard with sharp silhouette and a thin ember-orange edge glow; distinct from ash crystal.
